report:
## Conclusion

The evidence is **suggestive but not conclusive**. Vegetarian diets are consistently associated with lower cardiovascular/ischemic heart disease mortality, but the link to overall (all-cause) life expectancy is weaker and less certain.

- A 2021 meta-analysis found vegetarian diets reduced ischemic heart disease mortality but had **no significant effect on all-cause or cerebrovascular mortality**, and rated the overall evidence as low certainty (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34611632/).
- A comprehensive review of vegetarian/vegan cohorts concluded that **overall mortality is similar between vegetarians and comparable non-vegetarians**, though vegetarians fare better than the general population—likely reflecting healthier lifestyles (less smoking, more exercise, higher socioeconomic status) rather than diet alone (https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/proceedings-of-the-nutrition-society/article/longterm-health-of-vegetarians-and-vegans/263822873377096A7BAC4F887D42A4CA).
- The large Adventist Health Study-2 cohort did find reduced all-cause mortality among vegetarians (especially vegans and pesco-vegetarians) versus non-vegetarians, but this population is unusual (health-conscious, low smoking/alcohol rates), limiting generalizability (https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamainternalmedicine/fullarticle/1710093).
- Newer plant-based diet index research shows that **diet quality matters more than simply avoiding meat**: "healthful" plant-based diets rich in whole grains, vegetables, and legumes are linked to lower mortality, while "unhealthful" plant-based diets (refined carbs, sugar) are not protective (https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2025.1518519/full).

**Bottom line:** All studies are observational, so causation can't be firmly established, and confounding by lifestyle factors is likely. A well-planned vegetarian diet emphasizing whole plant foods is associated with reduced cardiovascular disease risk and may modestly extend life expectancy, but claiming vegetarianism itself *causes* longer life compared to meat-eating overstates current evidence.
